room_rent.note: Room rent limit not stated in wording; sub-limits table implies differential billing applies. Refer policy schedule.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under in-patient benefit but no specific cap stated in wording.

copayment.note: 10% co-pay on all admissible claims in non-network hospitals; 10% co-pay for insured above 60 years irrespective of network/non-network.

sub_limits.note: Cataract ₹20k/eye, Hysterectomy ₹35k, Gall bladder ₹35k, Piles ₹20k, Fissure/Fistula/Sinus ₹20k, Nasal septum ₹20k, Angiography ₹15k, PTCA ₹80k, Appendectomy ₹30k, D&C ₹10k, Hernia ₹35k, DNS ₹35k, Renal stone ₹35k, TURP ₹75k, CABG ₹1L, TKR ₹80k, THR ₹80k and more.

ped_waiting.note: Policy states 36 months or 24 months depending on plan; Secure Basic plan not explicitly mapped to 24mo in wording text, defaulting to 36 months as stated standard.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Most listed conditions have 24-month wait; surgical treatment of obesity has 48-month wait.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). No optional maternity cover mentioned.

cumulative_bonus.note: 10% or 25% per claim-free year up to 50% or 100% depending on plan; Secure Basic assumed lower tier (50% max). Enhanced CB up to 150% available as optional add-on.

restoration.note: Reload of Sum Insured is an optional cover; triggers after original SI + CB exhausted; available for in-patient claims only; cannot be carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: Period not stated in wording; refer policy schedule.

post_hosp.note: Period not stated in wording; refer policy schedule.

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary hospitalisation benefit mentioned in wording.

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to basic Sum Insured; OPD/day-care AYUSH excluded.

organ_donor.note: No organ donor expense benefit mentioned in wording.

ambulance.note: Emergency local road ambulance covered; maximum liability as per schedule (amount not stated in wording).

modern_treatments.note: No explicit modern/robotic treatment benefit mentioned; day-care list covers many procedures but no specific modern treatment clause.

consumables.note: Standard excluded items list explicitly excludes gloves, consumables etc.

global_cover.note: Policy valid only within India; treatment outside India excluded.

notable_exclusions: STDs/HIV, dental (non-accident), OPD treatment, treatment outside India, external congenital anomaly, prosthetics/external devices, refractive error <7.5D
optional_riders: Reload of Sum Insured, Enhanced Cumulative Bonus (up to 150%), Waiver of Sub-limits
